newsitem.title: SUDAN: Tribal fighting ends in western Sudan - paper.
newsitem.headline: Tribal fighting ends in western Sudan - paper.

text.p: Quiet has returned to an area in western Sudan where bloody clashes between rival tribes last month killed dozens of people and displaced thousands, a government newspaper said on Saturday.
Al-Sudan al-Hadith said life had returned to normal in Southern Darfur state and that many people who had fled from their homes during the fighting were returning.
Fighting between the Zaghwa and Reizegat tribes left between 60 and 100 people dead and is reported to have displaced 15,000.
Representatives of the two tribes signed a truce earlier this month to end the hostilities, which broke out over water and grazing rights. The tribes also accuse each other of armed robbery.
